theme: Yesterday agents got an execution model, a knowledge factory, and a bill. Today the fight is identity and control: Visa CLI lets a card-verified agent earn on Tempo, Signal and Apple draw OS-level lines around agents that can see the screen, Docker rebrands around agent sandboxes, T3 Code becomes the GUI for coding-agent fleets, Grok Bot actually files Amazon refunds, and CBC tests a newsroom pitch from an agent with no body.
